title: Account holds, liens and availability restrictions
workflow: Receive authorized hold instruction from qualified source
Verify account and authority against institution policy
Determine allowed operations, amount and effective interval
Apply hold with atomic state/control version change
Block relevant debits or activities via server-side enforcement
Release or modify only through authorized reviewed case
invariants: A hold may restrict availability without editing posted ledger history
Expired timer alone cannot overrule binding court order
Conflicting holds require explicit precedence and review
Cross-institution legal instructions are not automatically transferable
A hold must be auditable, reason-coded and reversible under authority
An unauthorized caller cannot apply or remove a hold
planned_tests: Legal hold expiry misconfigured does not silently release
Concurrent hold and payment governed by durable ordering
approval_gate: Qualified legal lien/attachment rules, institution operations controls and concurrency tests.
